name: stale_source_is_not_model_logic
why: The most common misdiagnosis in dbt triage, and the one this toolkit's troubleshoot-runs skill exists to prevent: only `stale_source` is fixed by re-running. A freshness failure reads as a broken model to anyone seeing just the test name, and sending an engineer to study SQL that has not changed in weeks is the expensive outcome. The evidence that settles it is structural and available in any warehouse — rows present and internally consistent, maximum timestamp old, nothing in the lineage changed.

failures.message: Source freshness: max(loaded_at) is 74 hours old, warn_after 12 hours, error_after 24 hours. Rows are present and row count is unchanged from the last successful load.
